text:
Maya Patel: Morning y'all — just assembled a tall IKEA shelf behind my desk and the morning sun + wood finish = constant webcam glare. Posted a pic: https://imgur.com/a/abcd123 (ignore the ficus leaning into the frame 😅). Any cheap backdrop/curtain hacks?

Tony Alvarez: Oof. Try angling the shelf or move the lamp behind the camera so the light is diffused. Command hooks + a tension rod + a cheap blackout curtain = 10/10.

Olivia Chen: Parchment paper taped to a cheap frame works as a diffuser too, if you want something temporary and translucent.

Samir Gupta: If you have a window film (one-way/privacy tint) it cuts glare but keeps daylight. Also, lowering camera exposure helps — on Logitech C920 I drop exposure and bump brightness slightly.

Maya Patel: @Tony that sounds promising, I have Command hooks. @Olivia can you DM a pic of your parchment setup?

Olivia Chen: sure — basically two binder clips + a tension rod across the shelf and a sheet of parchment paper clipped on. cheap and collapsible.

CameraBot: Heads-up: we ran a camera firmware rollout last night; some Logitech settings might reset to defaults. If your settings look off after a restart, reapply via vendor app.

Maya Patel: Ugh thanks CameraBot — that explains why my color profile was weird yesterday.

Tony Alvarez: Also pro tip: put a matte poster board behind the plant. Cuts reflections and makes the plant pop.

Samir Gupta: If you want a totally zero-cost hack, black garbage bag + scissors + tape as a temporary backdrop. Not pretty but effective. :grimace:

Maya Patel: Ordered a blackout adhesive film and a cheap rod. Will report back with before/after pic later. Thanks all! :blush:

Olivia Chen: Can we have a poll — who here uses real plants vs fake plants vs no plants on camera? :seedling:

Tony Alvarez: real plants  

Samir Gupta: fake plants (pets kill everything)

Maya Patel: real + disaster-prone ficus :joy:

CameraBot: Poll suggestion: start a quick thread in #random-polls if you want a proper tally.

Maya Patel: will do. And I'll post the fix after I install. cheers! :coffee:
